provenance.paper: Clarke, E. M., Emerson, E. A., & Sistla, A. P. (1986). Automatic verification of finite-state concurrent systems using temporal logic specifications.
provenance.citation: Clarke, E. M., Emerson, E. A., & Sistla, A. P. (1986). ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems, 8(2), 244-263.
provenance.locus: Section 4 (the model-checking algorithm by fixed-point labeling) and Section 5 (two-process mutual exclusion: the safety property AG ¬(c1 ∧ c2)).
provenance.notes: Two-process mutual-exclusion transition system in the style of the paper's example: states track (noncritical/trying/critical) for each process; no reachable state has both processes critical, so AG !(c1 & c2) HOLDS at the initial state.

expected.notes: No state is labeled with both c1 and c2, so the safety property holds at s0; no counterexample steps may be emitted.
